entities.text:
High Court Of Madhya Pradesh
 At Indore
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: 1] They are heard and perused the case diary.

2] This is the applicant's second bail application filed under Section 483 of Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023/ Section 439 of Cr.P.C. as he is implicated in connection with Crime No.354/2024 registered at Police Station Sanwer Distt. Indore (MP) for offence punishable under Sections 376(2)(n), 294, 504, 506 IPC/Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita, 2023 and section 5L/6 Posco Act.
The applicant is in custody since 12/7/2024.
3] Earlier bail application of the applicant was dismissed as withdrawn by the coordinate Bench of this Court in MCRC.No.9419/2025 vide order dated 24/3/2025.
4] Counsel for the applicant has submitted that the prosecutrix has been subsequently examined on 4/2/2025, and has not supported the case of the prosecution.

Although the prosecutrix was already examined at the time of earlier rejection of the bail application of the applicant, at that time counsel appearing for the applicant was not aware that the prosecutrix had turned hostile in the trial Court.

Thus, it is submitted that this second bail application has been filed along with copies of the statement of the prosecutrix, who has not supported the case of the prosecution and infact she NEUTRAL CITATION NO. 2025:MPHC-IND:17386 2 MCRC-20393-2025 has also given a no objection before the trial when the application for grant of bail was moved by the applicant before the trial Court.
Thus, it is prayed that the application be allowed.

sentences.text:
6] Havind considered the rival submissions and on perusal of the case- diary and also taking note of the fact that the prosecutrix has not supported the case of the proseuction and she has also given no objection in the trial Court where she was present in person, and also considering the fact that the applicant is lodged in jail since 12/7/2024 and the final conclusion of trial will take sufficient long time, this Court is inclined to allow the present application.
7] Accordingly, without commenting on the merits of the case, the application filed by the applicant is hereby allowed.

The applicant is directed to be released on bail upon furnishing a personal bond in the sum of Rs.25,000/- (Rupees Twenty five Thousand) with one solvent surety of the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial Court for his/her regular appearance before the trial Court during trial with a condition that he / she shall remain present before the court concerned during trial and shall also abide by the conditions enumerated under Section 437 (3) Criminal Procedure Code, 1973.
8] Accordingly, the application is allowed and disposed of.
(SUBODH ABHYANKAR) JUDGE das Mithun Devda vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 10 July, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/68483665/
